scenarios.name: last-customer-typed
scenarios.why: the operator types LGSE 0000000050: RECEIVE gives 15 bytes, the 10 after the transaction id go into LastCustNum; DELETEQ TS GENAERRS / GENASTRT / GENASTAT / GENACNTL (GENASTAT is not there: QIDERR, caught by RESP); WRITEQ TS GENACNTL '**** GENAPP CNTL'; the second WRITEQ (FROM WRITE-MSG-L X(13) LENGTH(23)) is past its FROM item: X6, the task judged up to it

scenarios.name: transaction-id-only
scenarios.why: LGSE alone: RECEIVE gives 4 bytes (not > 5), LastCustNum keeps its VALUE 11; the four DELETEQs (none there: QIDERR each), the first WRITEQ, then X6 at the second

notes: GenApp's setup transaction (LGSETUP, transaction LGSE in base/cntl/cdef121.jcl, a terminal transaction). It RECEIVEs the operator's line (an unformatted RECEIVE: the scenario's terminal input; STARTCODE 'TD') and, when more than the transaction id was typed, takes the last customer number from it; deletes TS queues GENAERRS, GENASTRT, GENASTAT and GENACNTL; writes GENACNTL's three items ('**** GENAPP CNTL', 'LOW CUSTOMER=...', 'HIGH CUSTOMER=...'); deletes and defines the named counters of pool GENA (GENACUSTNUM at the last customer number, the 48 statistics counters at 0); SEND TEXT FROM(WRITE-MSG-H) LENGTH(24); RETURN. Judged only up to the second WRITEQ: it writes FROM(WRITE-MSG-L), PIC X(13), LENGTH(23) -- ten bytes past its FROM item, which CICS copies from whatever follows in storage, a layout no oracle here can say (oracle_assumptions.md X6, REFUSED on both sides, the task judged up to it, owner decision on #4607). Every task reaches it, so what is compared is the RECEIVE and the first WRITEQ (DELETEQ TS is not an event on either side; it shows only in what a later READQ reads); the counters, the third WRITEQ and the SEND TEXT are not compared (the gap this case leaves, until #4050 settles X6 on z/OS).
